words.rule: each bred deck plays the middle meta deck by strength, the same fixed bar for every bred deck, on the same games against the other meta decks, in stages of 20 double rounds (280 games with 7 opponents, 240 with 6), up to 5 stages with the Medium bot (z 4.88, 3.36, 2.68, 2.29, 2.03); a deck the Medium bot did not show worse then plays up to 2 stages with the Hard bot on its own seeds (z 2.96, 1.97). After each stage the paired difference is judged with α 0.05 spent over the looks by an O'Brien–Fleming-type boundary: shown worse when its upper bound is below 0, shown better when its lower bound is above 0, could not tell at the cap. A deck enters unless a bot shows it worse; could not tell enters
words.guarantee: A bred deck that is truly no worse than its reference is kept out about 2.5% of the time or less by each bot.
words.detect: What it can detect: with 6 opponents (stages of 240 games) the Medium bot shows a deck worse 8 times in 10 when it is really 4.8 points worse, the Hard bot with its 2 stages when it is 7.7 points worse. It assumes a per-game spread of 0.59 with the Medium bot and 0.60 with the Hard bot for two different decks, measured on the recorded bred decks.
words.spread: Spread seen: 0.62 per game with the Medium bot (median of 8 decks), 0.62 with the Hard bot (median of 7 decks).
